description: A federated, evidence-led map of authoritative and supporting UK legal sources.
notices: Only the UK Legislation child bundle is currently loadable; the 36 legal-source classes are governed federation metadata, not fabricated child bundles.
Official effects cover the declared seed snapshot; independently accepted v3 topics, concepts and entity links are non-official discovery metadata.
GitHub Pages serves YAML-LD as application/octet-stream; JSON-LD is the strict transport fallback.

codex-assisted-v3.notes: Only independently accepted topic, concept and entity-link assertions are active. Candidate and historical v2 rows are excluded.

core.notes: Legacy compact core rows are a versioned projection. Snapshot currency is not a claim that every provision is current law.

legislation-effects.notes: Only assertions materialised from successful frozen official routes are counted; inaccessible reconciliation routes are reported separately.

relationship_summary.freshness_semantics: `current` means the frozen datapack is inside its declared refresh window. It does not mean that every legal provision is in force, unamended or suitable for reliance without live verification.

source_families.definition: Acts, Measures and equivalent primary enactments, including devolved legislatures.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Work identity, enacted and revised expressions, territorial extent, commencement and point-in-time state.
source_families.title: Primary legislation

source_families.definition: Statutory instruments, rules, orders, regulations and other delegated instruments.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Enabling power, making/laying/coming-into-force dates, version and extent.
source_families.title: Secondary and delegated legislation

source_families.definition: Bills and draft statutory instruments before enactment or making.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Stage, version, sponsor, amendments and explicit non-operative status.
source_families.title: Draft legislation and draft instruments

source_families.definition: Original, revised and point-in-time expressions and manifestations.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Exact version date, revision status, source manifestation and unapplied effects.
source_families.title: Historical and revised legislation versions

source_families.definition: Legal-effect relationships between instruments and provisions.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Affecting/affected identifiers, effect type, date, extent and application status.
source_families.title: Amendment, commencement, repeal and extent effects

source_families.definition: EU-origin law preserved or transformed in domestic law, plus related withdrawal instruments.
source_families.minimum_provenance: UK status, cut-off date, domestic amendments, EU source identity and dual licence.
source_families.title: Retained and assimilated EU law

source_families.definition: Local Acts, private Acts, byelaws and local schemes.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Making body, enabling power, confirmation/local procedure, geographic extent and current status.
source_families.title: Local and private legislation

source_families.definition: Treaties and instruments creating or evidencing international obligations.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Treaty series, parties, signature/ratification/entry into force, reservations and depositary status.
source_families.title: Treaties and international instruments

source_families.definition: Published judgments from courts, with binding force determined by court hierarchy and issue.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Court, neutral citation, handed-down date, judges, version, appeal status and selected passage.
source_families.title: Court judgments

source_families.definition: Published tribunal decisions; precedential force varies by chamber and appellate level.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Tribunal/chamber, citation, panel, date, appeal status and jurisdiction.
source_families.title: Tribunal decisions

source_families.definition: Orders, concurrences, dissents and other judicial outputs distinct from the main judgment.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Relationship to proceeding and judgment, author, operative status and version.
source_families.title: Orders, opinions and separate reasons

source_families.definition: Identifiers linking a decision to official neutral citation and report series.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Source-assigned citation, report reference, parallel citations and mapping provenance.
source_families.title: Neutral and report citations

source_families.definition: Cites, follows, applies, distinguishes, doubts, disapproves, overrules and appeal relationships.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Passage-level evidence, source/target identity, treatment verb, direction, court and date.
source_families.title: Precedent, citation and judicial treatment

source_families.definition: Court, tribunal, chamber, judge, jurisdiction and competence records.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Stable institutional identity, hierarchy, temporal existence and competence source.
source_families.title: Court and tribunal reference data

source_families.definition: Civil, criminal, family and tribunal procedure rules.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Rule version, amendment instrument, commencement, applicability and official passage.
source_families.title: Court and tribunal rules

source_families.definition: Practice directions, pre-action protocols and judicial procedural instructions.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Issuing authority, effective date, amendment history, applicable rules and exceptions.
source_families.title: Practice directions and protocols

source_families.definition: Official forms, fee orders, calculators and process guidance.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Form revision, fee date, deadline basis, jurisdiction and accessibility.
source_families.title: Forms, fees, deadlines and procedural guidance

source_families.definition: Definitive and consultative sentencing guidelines and ancillary materials.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Guideline version, offence, effective date, statutory duty and applicability.
source_families.title: Sentencing guidelines

source_families.definition: CPS, COPFS, PPSNI and regulator enforcement guidance.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Issuer, version, legal basis, policy status, effective date and exceptions.
source_families.title: Prosecution and enforcement guidance

source_families.definition: Regulator rulebooks, handbooks, standards, directions and binding requirements.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Regulator competence, rule version, legal instrument basis, effective dates and territorial scope.
source_families.title: Regulatory handbooks and rules

source_families.definition: Final notices, decisions, undertakings, penalties, permissions and appeals.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Decision-maker, subject, statutory power, date, outcome, appeal/review state and redactions.
source_families.title: Regulatory decisions and enforcement notices

source_families.definition: Statutory and non-statutory codes, manuals and guidance.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Statutory basis, duty to have regard, version, audience and legal-force qualification.
source_families.title: Codes of practice and statutory guidance

source_families.definition: Published findings, decisions, recommendations and adjudications.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Scheme jurisdiction, binding/recommendatory status, retention window, anonymity and review route.
source_families.title: Ombudsman and adjudicator decisions

source_families.definition: Bills, amendments, stages, debates, votes, committee material and deposited papers.
source_families.minimum_provenance: House, session, stage, date, speaker, bill version and stable passage anchor.
source_families.title: Parliamentary materials and Hansard

source_families.definition: Official explanatory and impact material associated with legislation or bills.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Associated work, publisher, date, version, explicit non-authoritative role and passage.
source_families.title: Explanatory notes and impact assessments

source_families.definition: Law Commission and equivalent consultation papers, reports, draft Bills and implementation status.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Project, report number, date, recommendations, government response and implementation links.
source_families.title: Law-reform publications

source_families.definition: Inquiry reports, evidence, rulings and official accident or investigation reports.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Statutory basis, chair/body, module, evidence provenance, publication and recommendation status.
source_families.title: Public inquiries and official investigations

source_families.definition: Eligibility, scope, calculators, provider finding and public advice routes.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Jurisdiction, eligibility date, disclaimer, service owner and referral limits.
source_families.title: Legal aid and public legal assistance

source_families.definition: Statutory notices, insolvency, planning, appointments and other public legal notices.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Notice code, publication date, issuer, geographic scope, permanent URI and digital signature.
source_families.title: Public notices and official gazettes

source_families.definition: Bodies, offices, powers, competence, geographic remit and organisational lineage.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Authoritative source, temporal identity, statutory basis, aliases and successor/predecessor.
source_families.title: Jurisdiction, institution and public-body reference data

source_families.definition: Court and tribunal listings, venues, hearing times and case references.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Licence, time sensitivity, suppression/anonymity, source timestamp and access restrictions.
source_families.title: Legal-service listings and hearing data

source_families.definition: EUR-Lex/CELLAR law, case law and preparatory acts relevant to UK legal interpretation or history.
source_families.minimum_provenance: CELEX/ECLI/ELI identity, language, consolidation, corrigenda, version and relevance to UK law.
source_families.title: European Union legal sources

source_families.definition: HUDOC and other international decisions affecting UK obligations or interpretation.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Court/body, application number, date, status, language and UK relevance.
source_families.title: European human-rights and international decisions

source_families.definition: Rules and decisions of legal-services regulators and professional bodies.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Regulator, authorised-person class, rule version, effective date and statutory basis.
source_families.title: Professional rules and legal-services regulation

source_families.definition: Historical records, archived websites and digitised material outside current publication systems.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Archive reference, series, date range, digitisation status, custody and access restrictions.
source_families.title: Archival legal records and web archives

source_families.definition: Law reports, citators, textbooks, practitioner commentary and news.
source_families.minimum_provenance: Publisher, edition, licence, editorial method and clear non-official status.
source_families.title: Secondary reporting and commentary
